title: A Red Fox Running Through the Grass
content: A red fox, also known as Vulpes vulpes, moves quickly through a grassy natural habitat. Its reddish-orange coat, pointed ears, and bushy tail are visible as it runs toward the viewer.

title: Red Fox Resting in a Snowy Landscape
content: A red fox sits calmly in a winter landscape surrounded by snow. The animal has reddish fur, pointed ears, a pale chest, and a thick bushy tail that stands out against the white environment.

title: Gray Wolf Howling in an Autumn Forest
content: A gray wolf, scientifically known as Canis lupus, raises its head and howls while standing among trees and brown fallen leaves. The scene shows the wolf in a forest during an autumn-like environment.

title: Gray Wolf Standing in the Snow
content: A gray wolf stands outdoors on snow-covered ground. Its thick gray coat and alert posture help it blend into the cold winter environment.

title: Domestic Dog Against a White Background
content: A domestic dog is photographed against a simple white background with few environmental distractions. The image focuses primarily on the dog's appearance and facial features.

title: Dog Standing Outdoors on Green Grass
content: A domestic dog is outdoors in a grassy area. Green grass surrounds the dog while the animal remains the main subject of the scene.

title: Brown Bear Sitting in Shallow Water
content: A large brown bear, or Ursus arctos, sits in shallow water. Its heavy brown fur and large body are clearly visible while water surrounds the animal.

title: Brown Bear Walking Across Snow
content: A brown bear is shown on snow-covered ground in a cold environment. Its dark brown coat contrasts with the pale snowy landscape around it.

title: Deer Standing Gracefully in an Open Field
content: A deer stands in an open field with a clear view of its body and natural surroundings. The wide grassy environment separates the animal from the more enclosed appearance of a forest.

title: Deer Standing Among Forest Trees
content: A deer stands inside a wooded forest surrounded by trees and vegetation. The animal is positioned within the forest rather than an open grassland.
